title: When Probing Accuracy Saturates, Fragility Resolves: A Complementary Metric for LLM Pre-Training Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2606.11375v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Standard linear probing declares a property "encoded" when a classifier on hidden states achieves high accuracy. The protocol works well on a snapshot but breaks across pre-training, with probe accuracy saturating within the first few thousand steps, leaving most of training invisible to the instrument.   We introduce fragility, a complementary per-layer metric defined as the activation-noise level at which probe accuracy collapses. Fragility is sensitive to both the margin of separability and the redundancy of representation, both of which keep evolving long after accuracy plateaus.   Applied to open-checkpoint language models, fragility recovers structure that accuracy alone cannot see. Moralized representations, our interest, emerge in stages, with high-accuracy detection of morally loaded words first and compositional encoding later. translated_title: 当探针精度饱和时，脆弱性显现：用于大语言模型预训练分析的补充指标
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.11375v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：标准线性探针在隐藏状态上的分类器达到高准确率时，声明属性被“编码”。该协议在快照上表现良好，但在预训练过程中失效，探针准确率在最初几千步内即饱和，使训练的大部分过程对该工具不可见。我们引入了脆弱性，这是一种互补的逐层指标，定义为探针准确率崩溃时的激活噪声水平。脆弱性对可分性边界和表示冗余性均敏感，这两者在准确率趋于平稳后仍持续演变。应用于开放检查点语言模型时，脆弱性揭示了仅靠准确率无法观察的结构。我们关注的道德化表示是分阶段出现的，首先是对道德负载词汇的高准确率检测，随后是组合编码。由于探针准确率本身仅追踪数据集在词汇层面的可分性，我们建立了该指标与脆弱性之间的互补关系，以更全面地分析预训练动态。
tldr: 本文提出脆弱性作为探针准确率的补充指标，通过衡量激活噪声下准确率崩溃的阈值，捕捉预训练后期准确率饱和后仍演变的表示结构，尤其揭示了道德化表示的分阶段形成。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces fragility as a complementary metric to probe accuracy, measuring the activation-noise threshold where accuracy collapses, capturing evolving representation structures after accuracy saturation and revealing staged emergence of moralized representations.
